description: This file defines the command-line interface (CLI) for Playwright, including commands for opening browsers, generating code, installing browsers, and viewing traces. It sets up command parsing, options, and associated actions.

methods.name: printInstalledBrowsers
methods.description: Prints installed browsers and their reference directories.

methods.name: printGroupedByPlaywrightVersion
methods.description: Groups browsers by Playwright version and prints them.

methods.name: launchContext
methods.description: Launches a browser context with specified options, handling proxies, viewport, geolocation, and other settings.

methods.name: openPage
methods.description: Opens a new page in the given browser context and navigates to the URL.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Launches a browser context and opens a page at the specified URL.

methods.name: codegen
methods.description: Starts recording user actions on a page and generates code in the specified language.

methods.name: maybeSetupTestHooks
methods.description: Sets up hooks for testing, including crash detection and process exit handling.

methods.name: waitForPage
methods.description: Waits for a selector or timeout before proceeding.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of a page at a URL.

methods.name: pdf
methods.description: Generates a PDF of a page (only with Chromium).

methods.name: lookupBrowserType
methods.description: Determines the Playwright browser type based on options.

methods.name: validateOptions
methods.description: Validates CLI options such as device and color scheme.

methods.name: logErrorAndExit
methods.description: Logs an error and exits the process.

methods.name: codegenId
methods.description: Returns the code generation language identifier.

methods.name: commandWithOpenOptions
methods.description: Creates a command with common open options for browsers.

methods.name: buildBasePlaywrightCLICommand
methods.description: Builds the base CLI command string based on language.
